event_push_callback_failed.description: Home Assistant could not register the message callback with Imou Open Platform. Check the callback URL and your App ID resource quota, then reload the integration.

init.title: Configure Imou Life
init.description: Pick a section to edit. Submit saves that section and closes the dialog.

general_settings.title: Status polling and camera defaults
general_settings.description: How often Home Assistant refreshes device status.

data_description.enable_polling: Turn off to skip periodic cloud refreshes. Entity states may become outdated. Setup and reload still fetch the device list once.
data_description.update_interval: Default 300s (5 minutes), range 30–900s. Ignored when polling is off.

camera_defaults.name: Camera defaults
camera_defaults.description: Live stream and PTZ defaults for this account.

data_description.download_snap_wait_time: Seconds to wait before downloading a snapshot. Default 3s.
data_description.rotation_duration: How long a single PTZ button press moves. Default 500ms.

event_push.title: Alarms, notifications, and recording
event_push.description: Receive cloud alarms via webhook. Suggested callback: {suggested_url}

data_description.enable_event_push: Imou cloud POSTs alarms to this Home Assistant webhook. Alarms also sync to the Imou Life app.
data_description.webhook_url: Required when event push is on. Must be reachable from the internet; if the suggested address is not, change only the hostname and port.
data_description.event_push_types: Which cloud messages Home Assistant should receive.

notifications.name: Notify on alarm
notifications.description: Optional. Leave empty to use automations only.

data_description.notify_services: Registered notify services on this Home Assistant. One message per alarm. Turn off **Notify on alarm** on a device page to skip that device.
data_description.attach_decrypted_thumbnail: linux x86-64 only; place official Demo libs in /config/imou_life/native/ (libLCOpenApiClient.so and libLCOpenSDK.so). TCM needs the Imou Life device password. /local/imou_life/thumbs/ is unauthenticated (URL holders can view for ~24h). If /config/www was missing, restart Home Assistant after the first thumbnail.
data_description.default_device_password: Used when a device has no per-serial password in Alarm image passwords.

local_recording.name: Local recording
local_recording.description: Shared folder and clip length. Per-camera **Record on alarm** is on each device page.

data_description.local_record_path: Example: /media/imou. Leave empty to skip. Folder must be in allowlist_external_dirs.
data_description.local_record_duration: Post-alarm clip length. Default 60s, range 15–180s. Uses live-stream quota.

alarm_image_passwords.title: Alarm image passwords
alarm_image_passwords.description: {password_count} per-serial password(s) configured. Add or update a device password, or finish to save.

menu_options.add_device_password: Add or update a device password

add_device_password.title: Device alarm image password
add_device_password.description: Enter the Imou Life device password for decrypting alarm thumbnails. Leave the password empty to remove a stored serial.

data_description.device_id: Serial number (SN) for this camera or accessory
data_description.password: Leave empty to delete the password for this serial

devices_menu.title: Choose and bind devices
devices_menu.description: Choose devices to poll, or bind a new device.

select_poll_devices.title: Choose devices to poll
select_poll_devices.description: Found {device_count} device(s). Unselected devices stay in Home Assistant but are not polled.

no_devices_menu.title: No devices found
no_devices_menu.description: This account has no Imou devices yet. Bind a device now, or save without binding.

devices_unavailable.title: Could not reach the Imou cloud
devices_unavailable.description:
The device list could not be fetched: {error}

You can try again, or save your other changes and leave the device selection as it is.

bind_device.description: Enter the device serial number and binding code from the Imou Life app or device label.

data_description.code: Optional. Leave empty if the device does not require a binding code

options.alarm: Device alarms (smoke, gas, human, picture change, etc.)

camera_image_failed.message: Could not get a snapshot from Imou: {error}

not_a_ptz_button.message: {entity_id} is not a PTZ button, so it cannot be moved. Target a PTZ direction button instead.

remove_device_missing_id.message: Cannot remove device {name}: missing Imou device id.
